tolerance: Exact structural equality, zero invalid references. Poland must contain exactly PLN01..PLN15, be declared worked, span at least five subject clusters, and the C15 Polish FOAK preset must use only declared facet values and have three blind spots.

baseline.reference: DATA-INTEGRITY benchmark, not a physics one: this tool computes nothing, it maps the normative landscape of nuclear projects by facility type, lifecycle stage and jurisdiction. The reference is an independent python re-implementation (/root/bench/ref/gen_kernnormenwijzer.py) of the record schema, the referential closure of the corpus, the jurisdiction visibility rule, the register filter semantics and the facet verdict rule, written from the documented meaning of the taxonomy rather than from the page's own functions, plus factual spot-checks of designations, titles, issuing bodies and current status against each issuing body's own catalogue.
